title_en: Benzoylcyclohexandiones, method for the production and use thereof as herbicides and plant growth regulators
title_de: Benzoylcyclohexandione, Verfahren zu ihrer Herstellung und ihre Verwendung als Herbizide und Pflanzenwachstumsregulatoren
text_provenance: Scanned WO A1 publication PDF from Google Patents (patentimages), 112 pages, no text layer at all (0 characters on every page). Every readable character in this run comes from the vision pass. The Google Patents HTML page was used only for the bibliographic fields above and for the DOCDB family id; its machine-translated English description was not read into any artifact.
abstract_zh: Es werden Benzoylcyclohexandione der allgemeinen Formel (I), Verfahren zu ihrer Herstellung und ihre Verwendung als Herbizide und Pflanzenwachstumsregulatoren beschrieben. In dieser allgemeinen Formel (I) stehen R1, R2, R3, R4, R5, R6 und R7 für verschiedene Reste, L für eine Alkylenkette, Y und Z für ein einatomiges Brückenelement.
title_en_note: This is the patent's own printed English title from field (54) of the front page, which agrees with the German (54) Bezeichnung, so there is nothing to correct. Recording a discrepancy elsewhere on the same page instead: the printed English abstract (57) opens 'The invention relates to benzocyclohexandiones of general formula (I)', dropping the 'yl'. Benzocyclohexanedione and benzoylcyclohexanedione are not the same class. Formula (I) as drawn on the front page is a benzoyl group, an aroyl carbonyl bridging a benzene ring to a cyclohexane-1,3-dione, which is what the German 'Benzoylcyclohexandione' and the English title both say. The abstract's English names something the patent does not claim. Also note the printed English keeps the German elision 'cyclohexandione' where standard English chemical nomenclature is 'cyclohexanedione'; the title is left verbatim as printed rather than silently respelled.
